settingsDocsAi.title: Documentation
settingsDocsAi.description: How the AI drafts edits to Word documents in this workspace, and who hears about it.
settingsDocsAi.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
settingsDocsAi.featureDescription: The AI never writes into a document directly. It drafts, and a person reviews the result as tracked changes they can accept or reject one at a time.
settingsDocsAi.modeLabel: Let people ask the AI for edits
settingsDocsAi.modeDescription: Turns off the Ask Aexy control, the background drafting job, and the comment trigger together.
settingsDocsAi.allowCommentsDescription: When the AI has a concern it should not silently guess at — a clause contradicting another section — it can raise it as a margin comment instead of rewriting the text.
settingsDocsAi.maxOpsDescription: A ceiling, not a target. Twenty-five tracked changes is a redline somebody can read through; two hundred is a rewrite wearing one.
settingsDocsAi.mentionDescription: Mention the handle in a Word comment and the AI drafts an edit answering it, then replies in the thread. This works for comments written in Word and uploaded, not only ones typed here.
settingsDocsAi.commentTriggerLabel: Draft an edit when someone mentions the handle
settingsDocsAi.commentTriggerDescription: Checked on the next save of the document. Each comment is acted on once, however many times the file is saved.
settingsDocsAi.handleDescription: Write {mention} in a comment to reach the AI. Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
settingsDocsAi.attributionDescription: The AI's changes carry a name, and that name travels in the file — whoever opens it in Word sees it on every tracked change and comment.
settingsDocsAi.authorLabel: The AI signs its changes as
settingsDocsAi.authorDescription: Not a person's name: a reviewer needs to be able to tell the AI's suggestion from a colleague's.
settingsDocsAi.notifyOwnerLabel: Tell the document's owner about drafts nobody asked them for
settingsDocsAi.notifyOwnerDescription: Applies to background drafts and comment mentions. Somebody who asked for a draft themselves is always told when it is ready.
settingsDocsAi.notificationsHint: Which channels those notifications use is your own choice, per event.
settingsDocsAi.autosave: Changes are saved as you make them.
